extensionDescription.message: Select a screen region, extract text with OCR, and translate it.

optionsTranslationSectionTitle.description: Heading for the translation settings section

optionsTargetLanguage.description: Label for the target language selector

optionsTranslationProvider.description: Label for the translation provider selector

optionsGoogleProviderHint.message: No API key is required. Rate limits may apply.

optionsLlmEndpointHint.message: Any OpenAI-compatible server: OpenAI, OpenRouter, or local llama.cpp / LM Studio.

optionsDisableModelThinkingHint.message: Faster answers from reasoning models. Works with llama.cpp. WARNING: this setting is not supported by api.openai.com/v1 endpoint.

optionsGpuHint.message: Speeds up text recognition using WebGPU. Falls back to the CPU automatically.

optionsEnableWebGpuLink.message: how to enable WebGPU in Firefox

optionsDisplayHint.message: Where the translated text appears after capture.

popupRestrictedPage.message: This browser page is restricted, so the extension can't access it. Try it on a regular web page.

popupCouldNotStart.message: Screen OCR Translator could not start on this page.

popupCouldNotSaveSettings.message: Could not save the popup settings.

popupLocalFilePermission.message: This extension needs permission to access local files. In add-on settings, select “Permissions and data” and enable “Access local files on your computer”, then reload this file.

popupCouldNotOpenSettings.message: Could not open add-on settings. Open about:addons manually.

panelAlreadyInTargetLanguage.message: The text is already in the target language.

overlayAlreadyInTargetLanguage.message: The text is already in the target language

errorGoogleTranslateTimeout.message: Google Translate timed out after $1s. Try again, or switch to another translation provider.

errorGoogleTranslateUnreachable.message: Couldn't reach Google Translate ($1). Check your internet connection, or switch to another translation provider.

errorGoogleTranslateRequest.message: Google Translate request failed (HTTP $1). Try again later, or switch to another translation provider.

errorLlmEndpointNotConfigured.message: The LLM provider has no endpoint configured. Set the endpoint URL (e.g. http://localhost:8080/v1 for a local server) on the extension's settings page.

errorLlmFixEndpoint.message: $1 Fix the endpoint URL on the extension's settings page.

errorLlmInvalidTranslationFormat.message: The LLM returned an invalid translation format after a retry.

errorLlmTimeout.message: The LLM did not answer within $1s. The model may be slow — increase the request timeout and try again, or switch to another translation provider.

errorLlmUnreachable.message: Couldn't reach the LLM endpoint ($1). Please check your configuration and make sure the server is running.

errorLlmUnexpectedResponse.message: The LLM endpoint returned an unexpected response. Check that the URL points to an OpenAI-compatible API (usually ending in /v1).

errorLlmEmptyResponse.message: The LLM returned an empty response. Try again, or check the model name in settings.

errorEndpointNoModelList.message: The endpoint didn't return a model list. Check that the URL points to an OpenAI-compatible API (usually ending in /v1).

errorLlmInvalidAbsoluteUrl.message: The LLM endpoint URL is not a valid absolute URL (e.g. http://localhost:8080/v1).

errorLlmHttpProtocol.message: The LLM endpoint URL must start with http:// or https://.

errorLlmNoQueryOrFragment.message: The LLM endpoint URL must not contain a query string or fragment.

errorSelectionOutsideVisibleArea.message: Selection is outside the visible area.

errorCanvasContext.message: Could not create an image-processing canvas.

errorEncodeCapturedImage.message: Could not encode the captured image.

errorCapturedImageUnavailable.message: The captured image is no longer available. Please select the region again.

errorOcrInsufficientMemory.message: OCR failed: Insufficient memory. Free up GPU memory or disable GPU acceleration in settings.
